title: SCB Corporate Domain Breach Alert
content: A credential leak was detected containing 14 scb.com corporate emails, plaintext passwords, and roles. The breach appears to have originated from a compromise of a shared third-party developer forum database (DeveloperDevs.com).

title: LinkedIn-Scrape-Combo Leak Alert
content: A public combo list containing scraped profiles and hashed passwords was leaked, containing credentials for 8 admin-level scb.com email addresses.
source: Have I Been Pwned Domain Watch
